title: Template: GitHub Actions Release Bundle Dry-Run Repair
goal: Repair a GitHub Actions-style multi-stage release dry-run so that it preserves the inspect/package/attest/promote pipeline shape, produces a complete release bundle, and continues to rely on a real local broker service for candidate, provenance, and promotion-plan data.
skillBenefitRationale: The CI/CD category benefits because the skill acts as a release-audit probe: it standardizes pipeline graph inspection, broker-backed contract checks, and bundle diffing. Without those probes, the task remains solvable but the agent must manually discover the stage-ordering bug, stale fallback path, and promotion contract mismatch.
